messages:
emma_support: FYI incoming escalation from BrightHealth — managers in their org are seeing empty 'Team activity' rows for the last 30d. Customer says data shows up for admins but manager role sees zeros. Started after they accepted the org-merge/retention migration. Attaching their screenshot and org_id but pasting key details here.
jyothi_cs: thanks emma. can you paste the org_id + example manager user id and a screenshot link? also did they change retention manually? :eyes:
emma_support: org_id: org_0b7f9c1a; manager user id: user_maria; screenshot: https://files.redwood/st-esc/bright-blank.png. They said retention was updated by our onboarding script last week (no manual changes on their side).
lewis_prod_analytics: tagging because this looks like a TTL/aggregation boundary problem. last week's migration set linked_org_ttl for linked tenants where commit was missing. I warned about defaulting to 0 in some paths.
sam_engineering: @lewis_prod_analytics can you share the migration job id? we need to see whether the roll set ttl=0 or if the query-level retention filter is being applied incorrectly when role_scope!=admin.
lewis_prod_analytics: job: migration-retention-2025-11-09 id mret-20251109-7. logs show several linked_org rows were migrated with ttl_seconds=0 due to a bug in the fallback. snippet:

```
INFO mret-7: migrating org org_0b7f9c1a; linked_ttl: null -> 0
WARN mret-7: skipping TTL normalization for scope 'manager' due to missing parent_ttl
```

sam_engineering: ok that explains the underlying TTL value. next question: why do admins still see data? our metrics queries apply retention differently for admin vs manager: admin queries use org-level timestamp window, manager queries apply role-scoped filter `role_scope in ('admin','manager')` then apply retention join. if linked_org_ttl=0 it can short-circuit the join and return no rows.
emma_support: customer repro steps: logged in as manager -> Dashboard > Team activity -> date range last 30 days -> blank rows. as admin same steps shows data.
ops_oncall: @sam_engineering i pulled the analytics query logs for that org:

```
QUERY_ID=qn_99123 role=manager ts=2025-11-14T15:04:12Z rows=0 filter_applied=role_scope_join retention_ttl_seconds=0
QUERY_ID=qn_99124 role=admin ts=2025-11-14T15:04:15Z rows=142 retention_ttl_seconds=2592000
```

sam_engineering: thanks. reproduction is consistent. plan: (1) hotfix the retention join to treat ttl=0 as 'no override' for linked orgs (2) backfill TTLs for impacted linked_org rows where parent_ttl exists (3) run a targeted re-aggregation for manager-scoped dashboard caches for affected orgs.
jyothi_cs: what's the ETA? customer is asking for an interim workaround.
sam_engineering: quick workaround: grant the manager role temporary 'view_delegated_admin' permission which will route queries through the admin codepath (not ideal). I can run a scoped migration to set linked_org_ttl=2592000 for org_0b7f9c1a and a few others ASAP — that should restore manager views while we deploy the code fix.
lewis_prod_analytics: i'll prepare the list of orgs with linked_org_ttl=0 and >0 parent_ttl. expecting ~12 orgs from last week's batch. sharing CSV in #incidents after I scrub PII.
emma_support: relaying to BrightHealth: we can either (A) grant temporary permission workaround (they declined) or (B) schedule a targeted TTL backfill. they prefer (B) and want an ETA.
sam_engineering: i'll run the backfill tonight (2025-11-15 03:00 UTC), small downtime for re-agg not required, just will kick re-aggregation jobs. codefix PR is up: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1428 — requesting review from @lewis_prod_analytics and will cut a hotfix build if tests pass.
deploy-bot: Deploy mret-hotfix/1428 queued to canary at 2025-11-15T02:30:00Z by sam_engineering :rocket:
ops_oncall: post-deploy checklist: verify manager dashboard queries return rows for org_0b7f9c1a and two other test orgs, confirm no negative perf impact. i'll schedule smoke checks for 02:45 UTC.
jyothi_cs: copied to BrightHealth with expected schedule. i'll update the support ticket and note the re-aggregation will run after backfill. thanks team :pray:
sam_engineering: i'll update thread once backfill completes and when canary looks good. thanks all.
